IBEW.text:
**Trampin the IBEW Indoor Locals — Sunday, August 16, 2026**

**LU-1426 Grand Forks, ND** is running hot right now. Parsons Electric's got **77 Inside JW calls** across two separate gang calls at Polaris Forge Data Center in Harwood, all at **$44.80/hr** with **$100/day non-taxed per diem** plus **$100/day incentive Mon-Fri, $150 Sat-Sun** on 6-10's. Hunt Electric's pulling another 10 at Grand Forks Air Base same rate, same per diem structure, 4-10's with Friday OT. That's real money stacking on top of scale—the incentive premiums are the play here if you can stomach North Dakota winter and don't mind the grind.

**LU-430 Racine, WI** has Microsoft Mount Pleasant locked down tight. Four contractors (Gerdes, Pieper, Staff Electric, Kelso Burnett) are moving **53 JW hands** all at **$62.51/hr**—flat across every call, which means the board's unified on pricing. Gerdes is the biggest move at 22 bodies; Pieper's at 13. All require Wisconsin JW or reciprocal, long sleeves, safety toes. Clean, predictable work.

**LU-613 Atlanta, GA** sits at **56 total calls, 315 hands deep**—the biggest board on this snapshot. Inglett & Stubbs dominates with 41 JW spots at QTS Fayette on **$40/hr**, 4-10's and 2-8's Mon-Sat, Saturdays optional. Miller Electrical's got 20 more at the same rate pulling medium voltage. Book depth here means expect some wait, but the volume is real.

**LU-494 Milwaukee, WI** shows **38 calls, 189 hands**. Cupertino's Port Washington Data Center job pays **JW wage plus $10/hr** on 58–60 hrs/week with drug test required. Pieper's service truck work carries foreman pay for drivers. Data centers are pulling serious OT across the board.

**LU-683 Columbus, OH** has **28 calls, 91 hands** at Cologix and ECX projects—all **$46/hr** with **5-10's+8** and **all OT paid at double rate**. McGraw Kokosing and ESI are the anchors.

**LU-1547 Anchorage, AK** is an outlier: 54 calls but only 71 hands, dominated by non-Inside work (temp laborers, tree trimmers, telecom). Inside JW calls are buried.

Data center construction is absorbing hands faster than anything else on the board right now—every major local's best volume is QTS, Barn, Polaris Forge, or similar.

LINEMAN.text:
**Trampin the IBEW Lineman Locals — Sunday, August 16, 2026**

**LU-71 Columbus, OH** — 46 calls, 140 hands deep. NEW RIVER ELECT. CORP. dominates with 40 JW Lineman on distro work running 6-10s with $125 nights-stayed per diem and $125 bonuses on 10-hour days (CDL required). Another NEW RIVER crew of 9 spreads across Southern Ohio on 4-10s with optional weekends, same per diem. CAPITAL ELECTRIC LINE BUILDERS pulls 6 for cable splicing in Johnstown at $100/day per diem, OSHA 10 and Class A CDL mandatory. Book's moving steady — solid regional work.

**LU-1426 Grand Forks, ND** — 24 calls, 130 hands. Parsons Electric is running 77 Inside JW across two calls on the Polaris Forge Data Center in Harwood at **$44.80/hr**, **$100/day non-taxed per diem plus $150 weekends**, and an extra **$100/day for ND license**. Hunt Electric adds 10 JW at the same **$44.80/hr** on Grand Forks Air Base work. Data-center build is pulling bodies hard.

**LU-84 Newnan, GA** — 26 calls, 91 hands. SERVICE ELECTRIC runs 17 JW on Social Circle energize work at **$46.80/hr**, **$150/day per diem**, 11-on-3-off schedule. Their transmission call (10 JW) bumps to **$51.80/hr** and requires Quanta Barehand Cert. INCEPTION ENERGY SOLUTIONS spreads 9 JW statewide from Savannah at **$46.80/hr**, **$100/day per diem**, grid experience required. Transmissi work is hot here.

**LU-583 El Paso, TX** — 9 calls, 83 hands. Summit Line is staffing 25 Inside JW on Project Miner (Santa Teresa, NM) at **$55/hr** with **$1121.00/week lodging** for 350+ miles out. Rosendin's Meta build (44 JW) runs **$40/hr** base plus **$15 incentive** for 90% of 60/week, all OT double time. Big desert plays pulling wire.

**LU-70 Forestville, MD** — 8 calls, 59 hands. Didado's transmission Old Field WV job tops the board: 20 JW at **$126/hr**, **$150/day per diem**, classified operator-transmission work. LU 1245 CA/NV ops at **$55.90/hr** across various sites. Transmission premiums are real money here.

**LU-291 Boise, ID** — 17 calls, 51 hands. VECA Electric's META 3&5 data-center build runs 8 Inside JW at **$65.33/hr** with incentive program and additional OT premium pay (6 more at same rate). Rosendin's Micron Admin adds 5 JW at **$45.33/hr** plus **$20/hr incentive**, **$200/day per diem** travel-eligible. Data centers are driving the West.

Data-center megaprojects — El Paso, Grand Forks, Boise, Chattanooga — are the real job engine right now, pulling steady hands into long-term commitments at premium per diems.

UA.text:
**Trampin the UA Locals — Sunday, August 16, 2026**

**LU-213 St John, NB** is running the hottest board in the union right now—14 calls hunting 141 hands on the Irving Oil Refinery shutdown. Stuart Olson and Lorneville are pulling 44, 39, and 10 journeymen pipefitters apiece on days, with another 11 apprentices running nights. This is full-bore refinery work, the kind of gig that clears your book fast. If you're East Coast–positioned, this is the move this week.

**LU-290 Portland, OR** has 28 calls and only 46 hands on the bench—board's thin and staying thin. Charter Mechanical is muscling through the Intel Ronler Acres project in Hillsboro with high-purity fitters and orbital welders. Harder Mechanical is also hiring BIM detailers and fitters for tool install work. Specialty skills matter here; this isn't volume work, it's targeted hiring on semiconductor and tech infrastructure.

**LU-140 Salt Lake City, UT** sits at 18 calls, 61 hands—the Sego Project out of BCS Mechanical is the anchor, pulling 15 journeyman pipefitters and 13 plumbers on 4-10s, 6 AM–4:30 PM with OT built in. DSI's QTS gig in Eagle Mountain offers **$10.00** on 5-8s with a 5-10s + 1-8 rotation. Started August 3; if you're late to the party, there's still movement.

**LU-776 Lima, OH** is fielding 9 calls on 32 hands with one call hitting **$53.00/hr**—Graham's Cenovus Maintenance work pulling combo welders and pipefitters. Gem and Nooter are running fab shop work with per diem **$125/day worked** and incentive pay layered in. Industrial fab and refinery outage work stacked tight.

**LU-525 Las Vegas, NV** has a single call—12 journeymen wanted at Four Seasons towers in Henderson, starting July 30. OSHA 10/30 card mandatory.

The refinery and semiconductor corridor is absorbing hands fast; shutdown and fab work is where the board depth matters.
